caveats: NOT A CURRENT SCREEN CANDIDATE — assembled because the name carries an operator follow decision — Clinical-stage heart-and-lung biotech followed under the QUALITY book, accepted by the operator 2026-09-01. One drug matters: TX45, for pulmonary hypertension caused by heart failure. Phase 1b was positive in both heart-failure types (HFpEF, and HFrEF topline 2025-10-29); the Phase 2 that decides it (APEX, PH-HFpEF) completed enrolment 2026-06-10, its independent data monitoring committee recommended continuation without modification in July 2026, and topline is guided to early Q1 2027. Cash of $227.1M at 2026-06-30 is guided to fund operations into Q1 2029 — the company reaches its own answer without needing to raise. The binding question is therefore what the price already assumes about that one readout, not whether a de-rating is overdone: nothing broke here, so the overshoot twin's question does not apply. The $300M-$10B band answers where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow; this name sits inside the band but fails the screen's entry gates on their own terms (down 22% from its 52w high against a 30% floor, and AHEAD of IWM over 180d), which is the screen behaving correctly rather than a gap to route around. The cap band decides where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow, so absence from it is not a rejection — read the verdict, not the absence: last evaluated 2026-08-24-01: FAIL (g1_drawdown FAIL).

business_description.value: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc., a biotechnology company, focuses on the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies to modulate the activity of G protein coupled receptors (GPCRs). It develops GEODe technology platform to enable the discovery and development of GPCR-targeted biologic medicines. The company’s lead product is TX45, a Fc-relaxin fusion molecule that activates the RXFP1 receptor, the GPCR target of the hormone, and relaxin. It is also developing TX2100 for the treatment of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia; GPCR modulator bispecific for treating fibrosis; and other GPCR modulators. The company is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts.
